Joins the store's own privacy-safe signals — order status over time, order-status transitions, order-note reason codes, gateway and webhook health

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_checkout_health_snapshot" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_checkout_change_risk · Private data: check_checkout_change_risk · Public sink: get_checkout_health_snapshot, diagnose_revenue_incident, verify_revenue_recovery.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_checkout_change_risk · Private data: check_checkout_change_risk · Public sink: get_checkout_health_snapshot, diagnose_revenue_incident, verify_revenue_recovery

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
